from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyTaxRefundInfo(BaseModel):
    """Financial data for a single company regarding tax refunds."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company reported in the document")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the financial line item (e.g., '收到的税费返还')")
    tax_refund_amount: float | None = Field(description="The amount received as tax refunds; numeric value for sorting")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period of the financial document (e.g., '2024 Q1')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_tax_refund_infos: list[CompanyTaxRefundInfo] = Field(description="List of extracted tax refund data from all documents")
